items.name: 01-hero
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, real estate photo, modern Australian coastal style, realistic proportions, clean and calm, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, plain garments with no prints, high detail. Palette: warm white, light oak, soft sage green, sandy beige, natural daylight. A walk-in robe in an Australian home seen from the doorway: a galley layout with built-in white oak open robes along both side walls and a clear walkway down the middle to a window at the end. Left side: a long hanging rail with neutral linen shirts and dresses on matching wooden hangers, all hanging from the rail. Right side: double hanging rails with folded shelves above, and a low bank of closed drawers. Light timber floorboards, a small woven rug, soft daylight from the window.

items.name: 02-lshape

A small L-shaped walk-in robe in the corner of an Australian bedroom: white open robe units on two walls meeting in the corner, one wall with a hanging rail of neutral shirts on matching wooden hangers, the other wall with adjustable shelves holding neatly folded jumpers and woven baskets. Light timber floor. Everything supported by the shelves and rails.

items.name: 03-shoes
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, modern Australian coastal style, realistic proportions, clean and calm, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, plain unbranded shoes, high detail. Palette: warm white, light oak, sandy beige, natural daylight. A tall white oak shoe tower inside a walk-in robe with shallow open shelves, each shelf holding one pair of plain shoes side by side: sandals, plain leather loafers, plain white trainers with no logos, ankle boots and heels, all sitting on the shelves. Next to it, a small upholstered ottoman on the timber floor. Straight-on view.
